title: Report a problem or idea
intro: Tell us what isn't working or what's missing. Your message goes straight to the DogTrainer team. We automatically add the screen you came from.
kind_label: What would you like to report?
message_hint: Briefly describe what you were doing and what went wrong, or what would help. Up to 2000 characters.
thanks: Thank you! Your report reached the DogTrainer team.
